dedupe_keys.name: cost model for carbon dioxide and hydrogen derivatives land and sea transport

description: The Mopo project deposits editable Excel cost models for moving hydrogen, hydrogen derivatives and carbon dioxide by road or ship. The Zenodo page says the archive contains separate road and sea transport workbooks, with user-changeable cells marked in Excel input style. Results are reported as total cost per tonne of cargo or per megawatt-hour of energy. The public ZIP is 28 KB and Zenodo states CC BY-SA 4.0. A modeller could vary technology or route assumptions when comparing hydrogen-network and carbon-management supply-chain scenarios. Rail is not covered because the provider reports insufficient reliable data. The page does not identify geographic tariff coverage, currency year or all workbook formulas; those limits matter before interpreting costs as current market quotations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these Mopo transport-cost workbooks. The ZIP was not downloaded, no formulas were inspected and no scenario result was reproduced.
inputs: User-editable road and ship transport cost parameters
name: Cost model for carbon dioxide and hydrogen derivatives land and sea transport
